clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, The Everstill Bridge still waits for repairs. Iron meant for the work went into weapons during the last orc invasion, and Redridge gnolls ambushed the replacement caravan from Stormwind.

You find Lakeshire's stone bridge across Lake Everstill unfinished. It links the western roads toward Elwynn Forest with the far bank and the northern passes. Recent orc incursions brought the town close to ruin. To survive, Lakeshire melted its structural iron into munitions, blades, and plate armor to repel the Blackrock invaders. The bridge was left incomplete and vulnerable.

Foreman Oslow asked the House of Nobles and Stormwind for fresh materials to finish the repairs. A caravan carrying iron set out, but Redridge gnolls ambushed it on the road. They took iron pikes and rivets to their camps in the northern hills. You can help recover the stolen supplies; without them, the bridge work remains stalled as gnolls and orcs tighten their hold on the mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor. We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.
Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt. If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, friend, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work, friend. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
